warning.titlePre: Mercedes Vario 614D/615D Timing Chain & Injector Seal Wear
paragraphs: Vario 614D/615D engines - OM612 and OM647, across the entire 1996-2013 production run - commonly show timing chain and gear wear, along with injector seal failure over time. This is a well-documented pattern shared with the equivalent-era Sprinter, backed by established Mercedes specialist consensus. We replace timing chain components, timing gears, injector seals and gaskets as standard on every Vario 614D/615D rebuild.
